biography.value: Seam Crawlers are scouts and compromisers — creatures that perceive weak points in physical and planar barriers and erode them. Their Phase Claw's DR reduction is their primary contribution to an encounter: a target that has taken three or four hits from a Seam Crawler is substantially less protected against everything else in the fight. Phase Walk allows them to pass through walls to flank, escape, or reach a target that has retreated behind cover. A summoner who uses one to pre-erode a high-DR target's defenses before committing larger assets will find it pays dividends disproportionate to its tier. The Seam Sense ability is also useful outside of combat — a summoner who wants to know whether a location has a thin boundary to a specific plane can direct the Seam Crawler to survey and report back.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Tremorsense 30 ft, Seam Sense 60 ft
system.attacksNotes:
Phase Claw [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 2), Reach: 5 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 6 damage (4 + 2 Str); target's DR reduced by 1 for 1 minute.
  • Margin 2: 6 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 force damage (Ignore DR); DR reduced by 2 for 1 minute.
  • Margin 3: 6 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 force damage; DR reduced by 3 for 1 minute.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Phase Walk: Once per round, can move through a single solid object up to 5 feet thick as part of its movement. It must end its movement in a legal (unoccupied, solid-floored) space. DR Erosion: The DR reduction from Phase Claw stacks across hits. A target that has been hit twice has DR reduced by 2 (or more, depending on margins). This reduction applies to all damage types.
